description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractRecipient' in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the mail plugin namespace. The class declares two abstract methods for obtaining an email address and a recipient's name, serving as a base for other recipient classes within the mailing system.

classes.name: AbstractRecipient
classes.description: An abstract class that outlines the methods for email recipients, requiring subclasses to implement methods for getting email address and name.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the email address of the recipient.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the full name of the recipient.
